activity_summary: After the king, James was in the yard in both cloaks. You said you did not hear a price. He said six fingers is not a price, and that he is not ready to say a sum. You did not make the neighbours into a verdict in the yard. No figure was spoken.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a price a second time, and went toward home.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Wore both cloaks, and would not say a sum.

topics: six fingers is not a sum

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: Both cloaks. He said you said both. The king is done.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I hear you, Master Burbage. I do not hear a price.

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: Six fingers is not a price. A dry room is not a price.
